name: Challenge Mitigation
description: IP-based challenge mitigation: serve a one-time challenge on selected paths, then whitelist the visitor's IP.
project_description: Challenge Mitigation is a lightweight application-layer anti-abuse module for Drupal 10 and 11. It intercepts anonymous requests to configured paths (or the whole site) via a KernelEvents::REQUEST subscriber and serves a one-time challenge page. Once a visitor passes, their client IP is stored in a cm_whitelist_ip content entity and bypasses the challenge for a configurable duration (default 24h), with expired entries purged by cron. It offers three challenge modes (transparent automatic JS, hard manual submission, and adaptive-hard that forces the hard mode for suspicious User-Agents), optional integration with the contrib CAPTCHA module in hard mode, manual IP allow-lists (IPv4/IPv6/CIDR) and manual User-Agent regex allow-lists, an optional signed cookie to remember passing browsers, and an option to skip authenticated users. The maintainers state it is not a replacement for a WAF but a pragmatic Drupal-level mitigation layer.
